    The characteristic-two step for A₀ #

    The proof of Proposition 8.3(1) (main-theorems.tex) on A₀: with the rows S of Proposition 6.1 and their dual mesh weights, choose for each row with a nonzero class the indicator of Proposition 11.2 supplied by Corollary 10.5, form the binary family and apply Proposition 7.9 (char2_core).

    Deviation (weights): the integer weights used for the characters are those of the mesh weight w = (w_R)_{R ∈ S} × length built from the dual mesh weights of Proposition 6.1 (dualWt), with values in ℤ^S × ℤ. The residual characters are then (e_R, deg), part of an evident integer basis (latBasis); this replaces Proposition 7.5 and Lemma 7.4 here (which need a connected Auslander–Reiten quiver). Corollary 10.5 is an explicit hypothesis of char2_A0; it is discharged by cor105Hyp in FinalBasis.lean.

                          ∃ (n : ℕ) (E : Fin n → Quotient (SysD D v₀ hF Wd).pairSetoid) (qd : Fin n → ℕ), (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < qd j ∧ LenGrading.IsRel₂ (VxA0 D v₀ hF Wd) ((SysD D v₀ hF Wd).transp k (ΘD D v₀ hF Wd) ((SysD D v₀ hF Wd).muE k (E j))) ∧ LenGrading.IsCocycle₂ ((SysD D v₀ hF Wd).transp k (ΘD D v₀ hF Wd) ((SysD D v₀ hF Wd).muE k (E j))) ∧ (lenA0 D ⋯).HasDeg₂ (qd j) ((SysD D v₀ hF Wd).transp k (ΘD D v₀ hF Wd) ((SysD D v₀ hF Wd).muE k (E j)))) ∧ ∀ (q : ℕ), 0 < q → ∀ (φ : (CatAlg.Alg D.F0)ᵐᵒᵖ →ₗ[k] (CatAlg.Alg D.F0)ᵐᵒᵖ →ₗ[k] (CatAlg.Alg D.F0)ᵐᵒᵖ), LenGrading.IsRel₂ (VxA0 D v₀ hF Wd) φ → (lenA0 D ⋯).HasDeg₂ q φ → LenGrading.IsCocycle₂ φ → ∃ (cf : Fin n → k) (f : (CatAlg.Alg D.F0)ᵐᵒᵖ →ₗ[k] (CatAlg.Alg D.F0)ᵐᵒᵖ), LenGrading.IsRel₁ (VxA0 D v₀ hF Wd) f ∧ (lenA0 D ⋯).HasDeg₁ q f ∧ φ = ∑ j : Fin n with qd j = q, cf j • (SysD D v₀ hF Wd).transp k (ΘD D v₀ hF Wd) ((SysD D v₀ hF Wd).muE k (E j)) + LenGrading.cobdry k f

                          Remark 11.5, surjectivity: the indicator cocycles of Proposition 11.2 (transported to A₀) span HH²(A₀)_{>0}. Every normalized relative cocycle of positive internal degree q is a combination of indicators μ_{E_j} of degree q plus a relative coboundary (the indicators being normalized relative cocycles of positive degree).
